_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Checking products against Merchant Center rules...

description:
Best for: "what would Google Merchant Center reject?" or "are my barcodes valid?". Checks GTIN length and check digit, duplicate GTINs, long, promotional or all-capital titles, missing descriptions, links, images, brand and price.
Returns: a summary (products, no_gtin, bad_gtin, long_title, no_description), up to 200 issues (one per product and rule, with detail) and notes on checks that could not run.
Input tips: send exactly one of csv (a Shopify product CSV or a Google Merchant feed file) or domain (a store address such as example.com). Domain mode reads the public product feed once, after robots.txt. That feed has no barcodes, so no_gtin and bad_gtin are null; use a CSV for GTINs. Errors: both_given, missing_source, csv_too_large, or a feed refusal such as not_public; then ask for the CSV.
Not for: Shopify import errors (use csv_import_preflight) or alt text (use listing_text_audit). It submits nothing to Google.

csv.description: The full text of a Shopify product CSV, header row first, such as "Title,URL handle,Description,Vendor,Price,...". Paste the file exported from Shopify admin (Products > Export) as it is. At most 2 MB; split a larger file by rows and repeat the header in each part. Example call: {"csv": "Title,URL handle,Price\nWool Beanie,wool-beanie,24.00"}

domain.description: A store address such as example.com, sent instead of csv (send exactly one of the two). The store's public /products.json is read once (at most 5 pages of 250 products), after its robots.txt. Large stores often block it; then ask the user for the CSV. Example call: {"domain": "example.com"}

name: merchant_feed_check

feed_truncated.description: Present and true when the store has more products than the 5 pages read

host.description: The store host that was read, in domain mode only

issues.description: One entry per product and rule, at most 200

detail.description: What is wrong and what Merchant Center expects

handle.description: The product's URL handle (the item id for a Google Merchant feed file)

rule.description: Rule id, such as bad-gtin or title-too-long

notes.description: Checks that could not be made, and why

source.description: Where the products came from: the csv text or the store's public feed (domain)

summary.description: no_gtin and bad_gtin are null when the source has no barcodes to check.

bad_gtin.description: Products with a barcode that fails the GTIN length, digit or check-digit test

long_title.description: Products whose title is over 150 characters

no_gtin.description: Products with a variant that has no barcode

totalIssues.description: All issues, before the list was cut to 200

truncated.description: True when there were more than 200 issues

title: Check products for Merchant Center rules
